name: promo_rate_daily_accrual_month_end_credit
question_template: A fictional digital savings account opens on day 1 of month one with {OPEN_BAL} USD. Month one has {M1_DAYS} days; month two has {M2_DAYS} days. Daily interest is the balance at the beginning of that day times the annual rate in effect, as a ratio, divided by 365. Interest is credited only at the end of the last day of each month and earns interest from the next month. A promotional annual rate of {PROMO_RATE} percent applies for the account's first {PROMO_DAYS} days (opening day is day 1, counted across the month boundary); afterwards the standard annual rate of {STD_RATE} percent applies. A deposit of {DEPOSIT} USD arrives at the beginning of day {DEP_DAY} of month two and earns interest from that day. What is the closing balance in USD at the end of month two after month-two interest is credited?

slots.description: Interest credited at the end of month one
Balance at the beginning of day 1 of month two before the deposit
Interest credited at the end of month two

program:
from fractions import Fraction

def solve():
    b0 = Fraction(P["OPEN_BAL"])
    m1 = int(P["M1_DAYS"])
    m2 = int(P["M2_DAYS"])
    promo = Fraction(P["PROMO_RATE"]) / 100
    std = Fraction(P["STD_RATE"]) / 100
    n = int(P["PROMO_DAYS"])
    dep = Fraction(P["DEPOSIT"])
    k = int(P["DEP_DAY"])
    if k < 1 or k > m2:
        raise ValueError("deposit day outside month two")
    if n < 0 or n > m1 + m2:
        raise ValueError("promotional period outside the two months")
    # month one: balance constant at b0 (interest not credited until month end)
    i1 = Fraction(0)
    for d in range(1, m1 + 1):
        rate = promo if d <= n else std
        i1 += b0 * rate / 365
    b1 = b0 + i1
    # month two: deposit at beginning of day k, promo may spill over
    i2 = Fraction(0)
    for d in range(1, m2 + 1):
        life_day = m1 + d
        rate = promo if life_day <= n else std
        bal = b1 + dep if d >= k else b1
        i2 += bal * rate / 365
    closing = b1 + dep + i2
    return {
        "final": closing,
        "interest_month_one": i1,
        "balance_start_month_two": b1,
        "interest_month_two": i2,
    }
